aviation_incidents.headline: 易捷航空A321neo飛行兩分鐘後引擎失速並轉降 備用機接送乘客
aviation_incidents.summary: 易捷航空一架空中巴士A321neo於2026年11月26日發生飛行中引擎關閉，該航班飛行兩分鐘後引擎失速並轉降。飛機仍停在愛丁堡，易捷航空派出備用機接送乘客前往目的地；航班延誤六小時。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: easyJet A321neo Diverts After Engine Stall Two Minutes Into Flight, Spare Jet Sent for Passengers
aviation_incidents.summary_en: An easyJet Airbus A321neo had an in-flight engine shutdown on November 26, 2026, and diverted after an engine stall two minutes into the flight. The aircraft remained on the ground in Edinburgh; easyJet sent a spare jet to take passengers to their destination, and the flight was delayed six hours.

aviation_incidents.headline: 六起獨立航空事件分別涉及樹木接觸、跑道偏出、引擎問題與雷擊
aviation_incidents.summary: 六起航空事件各自獨立，未有資料指出彼此相關：FAST Congo的L410於2026年11月27日在Dilolo進場時接觸樹木；Fedex的MD-11於2026年11月25日在邁阿密著陸時衝出跑道；Delta的空中巴士A321於2026年11月26日在亞特蘭大發生引擎故障；Western Global的波音747-400於2026年11月25日在東京回滑時偏出跑道；France的波音777-300於2026年11月25日在巴黎附近出現引擎電子控制問題；THY的波音737-800於2026年11月25日在Batumi遭遇多次雷擊。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Six Independent Aviation Incidents Involve Tree Contact, Runway Excursions, Engine Problems and Lightning Strikes
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Six separate incidents, with no stated relationship among them, involved: FAST Congo’s L410 contacting trees on approach at Dilolo on November 27, 2026; Fedex’s MD-11 overrunning the runway on landing at Miami on November 25, 2026; Delta’s Airbus A321 suffering an engine failure at Atlanta on November 26, 2026; Western Global’s Boeing 747-400 veering off the runway while backtracking at Tokyo on November 25, 2026; France’s Boeing 777-300 having an engine electronic-control problem near Paris on November 25, 2026; and THY’s Boeing 737-800 experiencing multiple lightning strikes at Batumi on November 25, 2026.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 中國東方航空A330-300抵達桃園 監測紀錄180天未見相同營運者、機型與機場組合
taiwan_aviation.summary: 公開ADS-B觀測資料顯示，中國東方航空一架空中巴士A330-300於2026年11月27日抵達臺灣桃園國際機場，紀錄確認時間為06:10:12 UTC。監測系統過去180天未記錄相同營運者、機型與機場組合；本次確認僅依單一資料來源，沒有獨立來源交叉確認。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Eastern A330-300 Arrives at Taoyuan, With No Matching Operator-Type-Airport Combination in Monitoring Records for 180 Days
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Public ADS-B data show that China Eastern’s Airbus A330-300 arrived at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport on November 27, 2026, with the system recording confirmation at 06:10:12 UTC. The monitoring system had no record in the preceding 180 days of the same operator, aircraft type and airport combination. The arrival confirmation relied on a single data source and was not independently cross-checked.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 星宇航空擬發行3億股辦理現金增資 募資主要用於償還銀行借款
taiwan_aviation.summary: 星宇航空公告現金增資案，預計以每股新臺幣15.5元發行3億股，估募資約新臺幣46.5億元，主要用於償還銀行借款。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Starlux Plans a 300 Million-Share Cash Capital Increase Mainly to Repay Bank Loans
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Starlux Airlines plans a cash capital increase of 300 million shares at NT$15.5 each, expected to raise about NT$4.65 billion. The proceeds are mainly intended to repay bank loans.

international_aviation.headline: Norse Atlantic挪威營運子公司將聲請破產 所有航班已取消
international_aviation.summary: Norse Atlantic Airways於11月27日確認，其挪威營運子公司Norse Atlantic Airways AS因未能籌得足以維持營運的資金，董事會決定向挪威Agder District Court聲請破產。Norse Atlantic已取消所有航班並停止售票，旅客可能須另作安排，復航日期尚未確認；上市母公司Norse Atlantic ASA及英國營運子公司不在破產程序內。
international_aviation.headline_en: Norse Atlantic’s Norwegian Operating Subsidiary to File for Bankruptcy, With All Flights Cancelled
international_aviation.summary_en: Norse Atlantic Airways confirmed on November 27 that its Norwegian operating subsidiary, Norse Atlantic Airways AS, would petition Agder District Court in Norway for bankruptcy after failing to secure enough funding to continue operations. Norse Atlantic has cancelled all flights and stopped ticket sales; booked passengers may need to make other travel arrangements, and no resumption date has been confirmed. The proceedings do not include listed parent Norse Atlantic ASA or the UK operating subsidiary.

international_aviation.headline: Norse Atlantic申請破產並暫停所有航班 復航時間尚未公布
international_aviation.summary: Norse Atlantic已申請破產並暫停所有航班，復航時間尚未公布。巴基斯坦國際航空（PIA）表示，自11月26日起以自有波音777營運所有英國航班；PIA先前在英國航線使用Norse Atlantic的波音787-9，兩家公司10月簽署涵蓋兩架Dreamliner的濕租協議。
international_aviation.headline_en: Norse Atlantic Files for Bankruptcy and Suspends All Flights, With No Resumption Date Announced
international_aviation.summary_en: Norse Atlantic has filed for bankruptcy and suspended all flights, with no resumption date announced. Pakistan International Airlines (PIA) said it would operate all UK services with its own Boeing 777s from November 26. PIA had previously used Norse Atlantic Boeing 787-9s on UK routes; the airlines signed an October wet-lease agreement covering two Dreamliners.

The proceedings had so far not affected listed parent Norse Atlantic ASA or the UK operating subsidiary.
